text.p: AccuStaff Inc chief executive Derek Dewan said he was optimistic about the company's outlook for 1997 and 1998.
"Based on our internal growth momentum and favorable prospects for new acquisitions, we are optimistic about the outlook for the remainder of 1997 and 1998," Dewan said in a statement.
He said strategic acquisitions made during the past 15 months and solid internal growth helped the company exceed its growth objectives for the quarter.
The company has completed 50 acquisitions since January 1, 1996, including 10 during the first quarter of 1997, he said.

He said the company has a continual process of smoothly integrating these acquisitions into its system, and has increased its cross-selling efforts to take full advantage of the extensive range of services it now offers.
